name: Activity feed
description: Notes stack into columns beside the speaker.
ask: Stack the comments beside me as an Activity feed.

name: Annotate
description: Labels enter; a red X strikes one, a hand-drawn loop circles a word.
ask: Circle the pin with Annotate.

name: Arc flow
description: A thumbnail rides a dotted arc between two devices; a bar fills, then ticks.
ask: Send the reel from laptop to phone with Arc flow.

name: Beat showreel
description: Hook in bar 1, events on the beat, the last bar returns to the opening.
ask: Cut a Beat showreel at 120 BPM.

name: Before and after
description: Two phone frames; the After time counts down, then a feature row lands.
ask: Compare v1 and v2 with Before and after.

name: Big word
description: One spoken word fills the frame at a time.
needs: Words with times from the transcript
ask: Use Big word on "one pin, one answer".

name: Captions
description: One word at a time near the top; key words large, filler small, one accent word.
needs: Words with times from the transcript
ask: Turn on Captions with the accent on product names.

name: Chart
description: Labelled bars build from your data.
ask: Show the review rounds as a Chart.

name: Checklist
description: A panel whose items tick as they are said.
ask: Put a Checklist when I list my three steps.

name: Chip tally
description: A row of check chips grows by one per spoken item.
ask: Add a Chip tally for the three benefits.

name: Diagram
description: Process boxes and arrows draw step by step.
ask: Draw the review loop as a Diagram.

name: Film look
description: Grain, light bloom, vignette and optional mono, frame by frame.
ask: Give the whole reel a Film look, light grain.

name: Floating cards
description: Tilted cards rise and settle around the subject.
needs: Up to three clips or stills
ask: Float the three screenshots around me.

name: Framed speaker
description: The footage shrinks into a card on a dark ground; shapes draw in.
needs: Plate footage and frame cue time
ask: Frame me in a card when I say "here's the thing".

name: Letter swap
description: Letters exit, then replacements enter without overlap.
ask: Swap "describe" to "pin" with Letter swap.

name: Live grade
description: The footage changes grade on the word that names it.
ask: Warm the grade when I say "golden hour".

name: Motif carry
description: An underline travels out of one scene into the next.
ask: Carry the underline into the next shot.

name: Number cut
description: The frame punches in and blurs behind the next section number.
ask: Use Number cut between the three parts.

name: Phone
description: Scrolls your screens and taps through them.
ask: Show the app on a Phone while I talk about it.

name: Presenter split
description: An insert enters while the speaker is re-cropped beside it.
needs: Plate footage and an insert screen
ask: Split the screen when I show the app.

name: Prompt
description: A line types into an input, then Send is pressed.
ask: Type "make the headline darker" into a Prompt.

name: Section tag
description: A number chip and label wipe in at a corner.
ask: Tag each chapter with a Section tag.

name: Shape morph
description: A circle becomes a bar, then an open frame, in one continuous move.
ask: Join shots 2 and 3 with a Shape morph.

name: Text behind you
description: Display text rises between the footage and the person.
ask: Put "FOCUS" behind me at the start.

name: Title card
description: A title arrives word by word, then a subtitle.
ask: Open with a Title card: "The pin".
